articles.title_cn: 择校中的联盟可操纵性
articles.abstract_en: We compare the degree of coalitional manipulability across stable school‐choice mechanisms. Although no stable mechanism is group strategy‐proof for all school choice contexts, we show that the student‐optimal stable mechanism is the least manipulable by coalitions, whereas the school‐optimal stable mechanism is the most coalitionally manipulable. These results still hold when students can only report truncated preferences, when the set of coalitions is limited, or when schools cannot be declared unacceptable as long as there are more available seats than students. In contrast, if there is a shortage of seats and students have no outside options, the school‐optimal stable mechanism can be less manipulable by coalitions than the student‐optimal stable mechanism.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们比较了稳定择校机制之间的联盟可操纵程度。尽管没有一种稳定机制在所有择校情境下都是群体策略防篡改的，但我们表明，学生最优稳定机制是最不易被联盟操纵的，而学校最优稳定机制则是最易被联盟操纵的。当学生只能报告截断偏好、当联盟集合受限，或当只要可用席位多于学生时学校不能被声明为不可接受时，这些结果仍然成立。相反，如果席位短缺且学生没有外部选项，学校最优稳定机制可能比学生最优稳定机制更不易被联盟操纵。

articles.title_en: Physical versus digital currency A difference that makes a difference
articles.title_cn: 实物货币与数字货币：一种产生差异的差异
articles.abstract_en: This paper compares digital and physical currency, focusing on a single intrinsic difference: digital, unlike physical currency, allows the monetary authority to trace the monetary flows in and out of the accounts. We show that this technological advance in recordkeeping can be used by the monetary authority to improve upon physical currency and achieve efficiency in a wide range of circumstances.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文比较了数字货币与实物货币，聚焦于一个内在差异：与实物货币不同，数字货币允许货币当局追踪账户中货币的流入和流出。我们表明，这种记账技术的进步可以被货币当局用来改进实物货币，并在广泛的情形中实现效率。

articles.title_cn: 露丝、安东尼和克拉伦斯
articles.abstract_en: Nonpartisan voters can become polarized not because of ideology but because it is optimal for them to remain uninformed and cancel out the votes of uninformed voters on “the other side.” Indeed, when stuck in such a state of polarization, it is socially optimal to do so. Dynamics can lead an otherwise well‐functioning assembly into irreversible polarization. Reputation effects might only make things worse.
articles.abstract_cn: 无党派选民可能变得两极分化，不是因为意识形态，而是因为对他们来说，保持不知情并抵消“另一方”不知情选民的选票是最优的。事实上，当陷入这种两极分化状态时，这样做在社会层面是最优的。动态过程可能导致一个原本运作良好的议会陷入不可逆的两极分化。声誉效应可能只会让情况变得更糟。

articles.title_en: When autarky trumps free and costless trade
articles.title_cn: 当自给自足胜过自由且无成本的贸易时
articles.abstract_en: In the context of Krugman's (1979) canonical new trade model, we demonstrate that a country is better off in autarky than in free and costless trade when the productivity of its trading partner is sufficiently low.
articles.abstract_cn: 在Krugman（1979）的经典新贸易模型背景下，我们证明，当其贸易伙伴的生产率足够低时，一个国家在自给自足状态下比在自由且无成本的贸易中境况更好。

articles.title_en: Ratings design and barriers to entry
articles.abstract_en: I study the impact of consumer reviews on the incentives for firms to participate in the market. I develop a model of endogenous entry in which firms produce goods of heterogeneous, unknown quality. Consumers engage in directed search, and prices are exogenously fixed. A rater uses consumer reviews to construct firm‐specific ratings that are informative of quality and help consumers direct their search. The main insight of the paper is that suppressing the reviews of highly‐rated firms strengthens entry incentives and improves consumer welfare.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究消费者评论对企业参与市场激励的影响。我构建了一个内生进入模型，其中企业生产质量异质且未知的商品。消费者进行定向搜索，价格外生固定。评级者利用消费者评论构建企业特定评级，这些评级能提供关于质量的信息并帮助消费者进行定向搜索。本文的主要洞见是，压制高评级企业的评论会增强进入激励并改善消费者福利。

articles.title_en: Efficient investment, search, and sorting in matching markets
articles.title_cn: 匹配市场中的有效投资、搜索与排序
articles.abstract_en: We study markets where heterogeneous agents first make investment decisions and then engage in a costly search to form productive matches. The trading process is a random search and bargaining with explicit search costs. Despite potential hold‐up and matching problems, we prove that the constrained efficient allocation is an equilibrium: the agents' private incentives to invest and to accept/reject potential partners as they search are perfectly aligned with the social benefit. Furthermore, we establish a new sorting result for two‐sided markets, equilibrium existence, and conditions for uniqueness.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究异质性代理人首先做出投资决策，然后进行有成本的搜索以形成生产性匹配的市场。交易过程是带有显性搜索成本的随机搜索与议价。尽管存在潜在的套牢和匹配问题，我们证明约束有效配置是一个均衡：代理人在搜索过程中投资以及接受/拒绝潜在伙伴的私人激励与社会收益完全一致。此外，我们为双边市场建立了一个新的排序结果、均衡存在性以及唯一性的条件。

articles.abstract_en: We investigate the management of information provision to maximize user engagement. A principal sequentially reveals signals to an agent who has a limited amount of information processing capacity and can choose to exit at any time. We identify a “dilution” strategy—sending rare but highly informative signals—that maximizes user engagement. The platform's engagement metric shapes the direction and magnitude of biases in provided information relative to a user‐optimal benchmark. Even without intertemporal commitment, the platform replicates full‐commitment revenue by inducing the user's belief to remain “as uncertain as” the prior until the rare, decisive signal arrives and induces stopping. We apply our results to two contexts: an ad‐supported internet media platform and a teacher attempting to engage test‐motivated students.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究信息提供管理以最大化用户参与度。一个委托方依次向一个信息处理能力有限且可随时选择退出的代理人揭示信号。我们识别出一种“稀释”策略——发送罕见但信息量极高的信号——能够最大化用户参与度。平台的参与度指标塑造了所提供信息相对于用户最优基准的偏差方向和幅度。即使没有跨期承诺，平台也能通过诱导用户的信念在罕见的决定性信号到来并引发停止之前保持“与”先验“一样不确定”，从而复制完全承诺下的收益。我们将结果应用于两个情境：一个广告支持的互联网媒体平台，以及一位试图吸引应试动机学生的教师。

articles.title_cn: 利用数据改进稳健决策
articles.abstract_en: A decision‐maker faces uncertainty governed by a data‐generating process (DGP), which is only known to belong to a set of sequences of independent but possibly non‐identical distributions. A robust decision maximizes the expected payoff against the worst possible DGP in this set. This paper characterizes when and how such robust decisions can be objectively improved with data; that is, can yield higher expected payoffs under the true DGP regardless of which DGP is the truth. It further develops simple and novel inference procedures that achieve such improvement, while common methods (e.g., maximum likelihood) may fail to do so.
articles.abstract_cn: 决策者面临由数据生成过程（DGP）所支配的不确定性，而该过程仅已知属于一组独立但可能非同分布的分布序列。稳健决策最大化在此集合中最不利的可能DGP下的期望收益。本文刻画了此类稳健决策何时以及如何能够借助数据得到客观改进；即在真实DGP下，无论哪个DGP为真，都能产生更高的期望收益。本文进一步提出了简单且新颖的推断程序以实现这种改进，而常见方法（例如最大似然）可能无法做到这一点。

articles.title_en: News media as suppliers of narratives (and information)
articles.title_cn: 新闻媒体作为叙事（和信息）的提供者
articles.abstract_en: We present a model in which news media shape beliefs by providing information (signals about an exogenous state) and narratives (models of what determines outcomes). To amplify consumers' engagement, the media maximize their anticipatory utility. We characterize the optimal monopolistic media strategy, highlighting the synergy between false narratives and biased information. Consumer heterogeneity gives rise to a novel menu‐design problem due to an “equilibrium data externality” among consumers. The optimal menu includes false narratives, and can generate polarized beliefs and choices without any information transmission. False narratives and polarization also feature in a competitive version of our model, albeit coupled with complete information. Nevertheless, competition can make some consumers objectively worse off.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一个模型，其中新闻媒体通过提供信息（关于外生状态的信号）和叙事（关于结果决定因素的模型）来塑造信念。为了放大消费者的参与度，媒体最大化其预期效用。我们刻画了最优垄断媒体策略，强调了虚假叙事与有偏信息之间的协同作用。消费者异质性由于消费者之间的“均衡数据外部性”而引发了一个新颖的菜单设计问题。最优菜单包括虚假叙事，并且可以在没有任何信息传递的情况下产生极化的信念和选择。虚假叙事和极化在我们的模型的竞争版本中也存在，尽管伴随着完全信息。然而，竞争可能使一些消费者的客观状况变得更糟。

articles.title_en: A general theory of inverse welfare functions
articles.title_cn: 逆福利函数的一般理论
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a general theory to recover the inverse welfare function that rationalizes a given tax schedule as optimal. Our theory allows for complex environments including the presence of multidimensional tax schedules, bunching/jumping behavior, optimization frictions, general equilibrium effects, and externalities. We show that inverse welfare functions can be used to test for Pareto efficiency, construct Pareto improving reforms, and characterize the set of welfare improving local reforms, thereby extending previous results to more general environments. We show numerically that allowing for such generalities can have meaningful impacts on inverse welfare functions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文发展了一种一般理论，以恢复使给定税收schedule作为最优的逆福利函数。我们的理论允许复杂环境，包括存在多维税收schedule、聚集/跳跃行为、优化摩擦、一般均衡效应和外部性。我们表明，逆福利函数可用于检验帕累托效率、构建帕累托改进改革，并刻画福利改进的局部改革集合，从而将先前结果扩展到更一般的环境。我们通过数值方法表明，允许此类一般性可能对逆福利函数产生有意义的影响。

articles.title_en: Benefits and challenges of ambiguous product information
articles.title_cn: 模糊产品信息的益处与挑战
articles.abstract_en: We study the welfare effects of ambiguous product information for a buyer with α ‐max‐min preferences and a price‐setting seller. The buyer privately receives information about her valuation. We show that both the seller and the buyer can benefit when this information is ambiguous, and we characterize all possible combinations of producer and consumer surplus, as evaluated under ambiguity‐sensitive preferences. Ambiguity concerning the valuation perceived by the buyer when making the purchase decision can induce the seller to change the price. Before receiving information, ambiguity concerning the purchase decision can make the buyer optimistic about buying only for high valuations, which relaxes the participation constraint.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究具有α-max-min偏好的买方与设定价格的卖方在模糊产品信息下的福利效应。买方私下收到关于其估值的信号。我们表明，当该信息模糊时，卖方和买方均可受益，并且我们刻画了在模糊敏感偏好下评估的生产者剩余与消费者剩余的所有可能组合。买方在做出购买决策时感知到的关于估值的模糊性可以促使卖方改变价格。在收到信息之前，关于购买决策的模糊性可以使买方仅对高估值持乐观购买态度，从而放松参与约束。
